# BF6 Crash Helper

Version **0.3.0** opens a compact window inspired by the author's Gaze Lab interface. It starts in **English**, with an immediate **Deutsch** switch. Check compatibility, read the scope and explicitly choose Apply in the same small surface. A saved change or interrupted operation brings **Undo workaround** into that action area. Optional diagnostics remain behind **More tools**.

Changing language clears consent; selecting another game folder invalidates the reviewed plan. Busy operations lock review, language and mutation controls. The existing guarded two-file recovery engine, build/hash allow-list, verified backups, one-time elevated worker and update/conflict protections are retained.

**Experimental; Steam build 25851446 only.** This is not a confirmed universal game fix. Several successful joins were reported on the investigated PC after the change; the official update alone had still crashed. Direct proof of the successful base-map fallback and broader testing remain incomplete. [Exact scope and rollback](https://github.com/IamAngusU/bf6-crash-helper/blob/v0.3.0/docs/rapid-workaround.md).

The [README one-liner](https://github.com/IamAngusU/bf6-crash-helper/blob/v0.3.0/README.md#quick-start) downloads a version-pinned Windows x64 executable, checks SHA-256 and opens the UI. It does not apply the workaround or request administrator rights. No Git, Python, Node, web server or package manager is needed; supported Windows needs .NET Framework 4.8. Please review [the UI](https://github.com/IamAngusU/bf6-crash-helper/blob/v0.3.0/src/CompactForm.cs), [recovery](https://github.com/IamAngusU/bf6-crash-helper/blob/v0.3.0/src/MirakRecovery.cs), [worker](https://github.com/IamAngusU/bf6-crash-helper/blob/v0.3.0/src/MirakWorker.cs) and [launcher](https://github.com/IamAngusU/bf6-crash-helper/blob/v0.3.0/start.ps1) before execution.

Locally built and tested on Windows: **96 Mirak assertions in 22 scenarios**, 58 diagnostic assertions, 32 recorder assertions and 11 cache/UI scenarios, including compact UI language, stale-review and consent gates. English, German and synthetic interruption-recovery views were rendered and visually inspected. Tests use synthetic data; they do not approve real UAC, change a live game or run ETW. Hosted CI was unavailable for this publication; no hosted build attestation is claimed. The executable is unsigned. A matching hash identifies the published artifact; it is not a safety guarantee. Keep Windows protection enabled.

Author: [IamAngusU](https://github.com/IamAngusU). MIT. Raw traces, dumps, game files and recovery backups are not part of this release. [Forum drafts in English and German](https://github.com/IamAngusU/bf6-crash-helper/blob/v0.3.0/docs/forum-post.md).
